nodes.description: address public owner; privileged account used by onlyOwner checks and fee recipient
uint public _totalSupply; total token supply, mutated by issue/redeem/destroyBlackFunds
mapping(address=>uint) public balances; per-account token balances
uint public basisPointsRate; fee rate in basis points, owner configurable
uint public maximumFee; cap on transfer fee, owner configurable
uint public constant MAX_UINT; sentinel allowance meaning infinite
bool public paused; emergency stop flag
uint8 public decimals; token decimals used to scale maximumFee
address public upgradedAddress; arbitrary external contract used for delegation when deprecated
bool public deprecated; switches ERC20 entry points to external delegation
BasicToken.transfer(address _to,uint _value) onlyPayloadSize; moves balances and takes fee
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) onlyPayloadSize; spends allowance and moves balances
Pausable.pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false
BlackList.destroyBlackFunds(address _blackListedUser) onlyOwner; zeroes balance and reduces supply
EpayToken.transfer(address _to,uint _value) whenNotPaused; blacklist checks then delegation or super.transfer
EpayToken.transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) whenNotPaused; blacklist checks then delegation
EpayToken.balanceOf(address who) constant; delegation or super.balanceOf
EpayToken.deprecate(address _upgradedAddress) onlyOwner; enables delegation to new contract
EpayToken.issue(uint amount) onlyOwner; mints to owner
EpayToken.redeem(uint amount) onlyOwner; burns from owner
EpayToken.setParams(uint newBasisPoints,uint newMaxFee) onlyOwner; sets fee parameters
msg.sender; caller identity used for ownership, balances and allowances
Arithmetic balances[owner] += amount and _totalSupply += amount in issue
Arithmetic _totalSupply -= amount and balances[owner] -= amount in redeem
Fee and balance arithmetic in BasicToken.transfer (mul/div fee, sub/add balances)
Allowance and balance arithmetic in StandardToken.transferFrom
maximumFee = newMaxFee.mul(10**uint256(decimals)) scaling arithmetic in setParams
